# plot_maxima { #mofography.threejs_viz.plot_maxima }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Maxima markers from seg dict or grid inputs (Three.js).

```python
threejs_viz.plot_maxima(
    seg_or_dgrid,
    atoms_or_maxima=None,
    ase_atoms=None,
    *,
    seg=None,
    hide_periodic=False,
    name='Maxima',
    cscale=None,
    trace_id=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Build Three.js maxima point traces from a seg dict or raw grid arrays.
